deviations_from_the_spec: Layout: the build is flat, so cost.mjs imports ./lib.mjs and finds its default inputs at ../cost-inputs.json (the contract layout, tcb/scripts/..) and, when that does not exist, ./cost-inputs.json beside it. The first existing one is used.

P in from-transcripts: the spec says the median first-call context over the role's sessions. A successor attempt (epoch >= 2) starts with the reloaded state as well, and with three epochs the median would equal the second attempt's context and give S0 = 0. So P leaves attempt sessions of epoch >= 2 out whenever the role has an earlier session; helper and coordinator roles are unaffected. S0 and sigma are then measured from the successors, as the spec says. The change is one line (buildRoles). If the literal reading is wanted, drop the filter and change the assertions on P and S0 in T10.
g counts only positive steps between calls: a zero step is neither averaged nor counted as a fall.

compute and predict output is rounded to the precision cost.js prints (k to 1 decimal, tokens to 100, counts to 10,000, ratios to 2 decimals), so result.coordinator.k_star is 17.6 and W_star 133200. predict arms are integers; predict's check.ratio has 4 decimals.

Packing question ids in the shipped inputs are upper case (F7-A-01), which the contract's key pattern (lower case) would refuse. The input check uses the same shape case-insensitively; the bad-id test uses 'not a key'.

Extra output beyond the spec: compute leaves carry t, k, spend, pack, separator, underflow; the from-transcripts result spreads the unit-costs fields and adds path, written, sha256, ledger_appended. No-transcripts case: exit 2 with reason no-transcripts and no file (the spec says 'no row/transcript to read' without a slug).
A flag a mode does not take (--ce on compute or predict, --text on predict, --g outside predict) is a usage error 66; --root on compute is accepted and ignored.
Errors raised after the mode is known (input-invalid, stale-ce, lock-busy, usage of a bad --g) keep the mode in the JSON line; a usage error from parseArgs or a flag of the wrong mode has mode null.
